title: The Hall of Clocks
text: A hall of a thousand clocks, from the floor to the high dark ceiling, each telling a different time, each ticking at its own pace. The noise is like rain. One of them, small and black, is ticking backward, and the hands on your own heartbeat seem to follow it.

options.label: Wind the backward clock forward, and set time right again.

outcomes.text: Time catches up all at once, and carries you a long way ahead.
Time catches up with you, and it has been waiting, and it is not gentle.

options.label: The wisest listens to the ticking, and tries to learn what it counts.

outcomes.text: All thousand clocks are counting down to the same thing, and it is not far off.

options.label: Smash them all, and end the ticking for good.

outcomes.text: Silence, at last, and something that was waiting for the silence.
